backlog.description: Read and update a project's SQLite kanban board.
backlog.invocation_notes: Users capture notes through commands or the CLI; agents use the backlog-board skill and CLI to read, claim, and update work items.

later.description: Claude Code commands for users to park notes and submit them later.
later.invocation_notes: User-facing Claude Code integration. The agent receives submitted notes; it does not use the plugin itself.

plain-english.description: Writing instructions for plain, declarative English.
plain-english.invocation_notes: The agent reads and applies the plain-english skill. No binaries are required.

python.description: Python conventions and a CLI for project bootstrap and verification.
python.invocation_notes: The agent applies the Python skill and uses python-style to bootstrap and verify projects. A user activating the skill does not make its actions user-invoked.
